description: Test suite for the ChatUI React component, utilizing testing-library and vitest to validate rendering, user interactions, and conditional UI elements in the chat interface.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines test groups for the ChatUI component.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines individual test cases for ChatUI behaviors.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up mocks and environment before each test case.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the ChatUI component into a virtual DOM for testing.

methods.name: fireEvent
methods.description: Simulates user interactions such as clicks and mouse down events.

methods.name: waitFor
methods.description: Waits asynchronously for UI updates after actions.
